QuestInfo.name: Explorer Book and Maple Leaf
QuestInfo.0: A letter arrived from Athena Pierce... with gifts inside!
QuestInfo.1: A letter arrived from Athena Pierce... with gifts inside!
QuestInfo.2: Athena Pierce gave you the Explorer Book and a familiar-looking Maple Leaf. Did it follow you all the way from Maple Island? Put it inside the Explorer Book to keep it safe.
